thread:
sarah_support: heads up — Acme Support just escalated. Their A/B rollout dashboard (exp-1423) is showing variant labels swapped and assignment counts that don't match the backend logs. customer pasted screenshots showing ~80% Variant B in the UI but our raw assignment logs show ~50/50.

sarah_support: customer says this started around 09:12 UTC and affects their billing/feature gating. they're pretty upset and asking if we can rollback the rollout or provide corrected counts. :frowning:

tom_eng_analytics: can you drop the dashboard link + experiment id? also which environment (prod/dedicated)?

sarah_support: https://console.redwood/demo/experiments/exp-1423 — prod (hosted). experiment id: exp-1423. they attached screenshots and a csv of the export.

ci-bot: Incident INC-2026 created and ticket opened in JIRA (RDW-4982).

jordan_oncall: I'm pulling raw events now. quick checks show assignment events from SDKs are coming in at roughly 51/49 over the last 2 hours. UI aggregated counts show ~20/80. So ingestion looks fine. Suspect mapping/labeling issue in analytics service or UI aggregation layer. :eyes:

tom_eng_analytics: running quick query:
```sql
-- counts from raw_events table
SELECT assignment_key, assigned_variant, count(*) as c
FROM raw_events
WHERE experiment_id='exp-1423'
  AND ts >= '2026-03-17T08:00:00Z'
GROUP BY assignment_key, assigned_variant
ORDER BY c DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Results:
```
assignment_key | assigned_variant | c
--------------|------------------|----
user:hash123  | control          | 1200
user:hash456  | treatment        | 1150
...
```
So raw_events show control ~49% treatment ~51% (roughly even).

maria_product: that matches what support said. UI shows labels swapped — could the frontend be resolving variant display names against the current rollout config rather than the config snapshot at event time? There was a small change last week to variant normalization.

tom_eng_analytics: good call. I grep'd the event payloads for variant_key vs variant_label. Older SDKs wrote variant_label as 'Control' vs 'control' differences. Our new UI code lowercases labels and then applies the latest mapping table when summarizing. If someone renamed variants in the control plane (e.g., 'control' -> 'baseline' last night), the UI can remap older assignment keys to new labels incorrectly.

jordan_oncall: repro steps I used locally:
1) pick exp-1423
2) query aggregated_counts service for window 08:00-10:00 UTC
3) compare to raw_events group by assigned_variant
Observed: aggregated_counts groups by mapped_label (via latest rollout metadata) -> gives skewed distribution.

sarah_support: customer asked why their billing shows features enabled 80% of the time (so costs increased). They want either corrected historical counts (CSV) or to rollback the rollout to previous variant mapping.

alex_sre: rollback option: we can pin the UI aggregation to use rollout snapshots (index by event.ts) but that's a change requiring migration. Short-term we can provide a corrected CSV from raw_events and a manual reconciliation. I can run the export and share within 30min.

maria_product: proposed fix: analytics should join raw events on the rollout snapshot table keyed by experiment_id + snapshot_ts (the snapshot used at assignment time). If snapshot_ts absent, fall back to event-time nearest snapshot. This preserves historical variant labels. We rolled out the normalization change which removed case-sensitivity and unified keys — that inadvertently caused the UI to show "latest" labels.

tom_eng_analytics: I created a branch that changes aggregation to prefer stored assignment_key (not mapped label) and only apply mapping using the snapshot_ts. Basic unit tests added. If we push to canary on console (canary tag) we can validate on exp-1423 without touching prod users.

jordan_oncall: marking P1 since enterprise customer impacted. I'll add oncall rotation and keep monitoring.

sarah_support: told the customer we have a bug in the dashboard mapping and are preparing a corrected export + a timeline. offered manual revert of display in their org while we patch. they accepted the export for now, want ETA.

alex_sre: ETA: export + reconciliation CSV in 30m, canary UI patch within 3 hours, full rollout after verification 6-8 hours.

maria_product: action items:
- tom: push canary aggregation change and run end-to-end against exp-1423 (verify counts match raw_events)
- alex: prepare reconciliation CSV and notify customer when ready
- jordan: monitor for other experiments impacted (search for experiments with variant name changes in last 48h)
- sarah: keep customer updated and confirm they want rollback if we can't fix within SLA window

tom_eng_analytics: starting canary deploy now. will post results here. :thumbsup:

sarah_support: thanks team — I'll update the customer in a single thread and attach the CSV when Alex posts it.

ci-bot: INC-2026 updated: priority -> P1, assignee -> tom_eng_analytics.
